commands.command:
cat > /root/ansible-timesync/playbook.yml <<'EOF'
---
- name: Configure node1 as internal chrony time source
  hosts: time_server
  become: true
  tasks:
    - name: Install chrony
      apt:
        name: chrony
        state: present
        update_cache: true

    - name: Configure chrony as internal NTP server
      copy:
        dest: /etc/chrony/chrony.conf
        content: |
          # Internal NTP server for the cluster - node1
          pool ntp.ubuntu.com iburst maxsources 4
          confdir /etc/chrony/conf.d
          sourcedir /etc/chrony/sources.d
          driftfile /var/lib/chrony/chrony.drift
          ntsdumpdir /var/lib/chrony
          logdir /var/log/chrony
          maxupdateskew 100.0
          rtcsync
          makestep 1 3
          leapsectz right/UTC

          # Allow the cluster subnet to query this server
          allow 10.100.123.0/24

          # Serve time even if not yet synced to an upstream source
          local stratum 10
        owner: root
        group: root
        mode: "0644"
      notify: restart chrony

    - name: Ensure chrony is enabled and running
      systemd:
        name: chrony
        enabled: true
        state: started

  handlers:
    - name: restart chrony
      systemd:
        name: chrony
        state: restarted

- name: Configure node2 to sync against node1
  hosts: time_client
  become: true
  vars:
    time_server_ip: "{{ hostvars[groups['time_server'][0]].ansible_host }}"
  tasks:
    - name: Install chrony
      apt:
        name: chrony
        state: present
        update_cache: true

    - name: Configure chrony to use node1 as time source
      copy:
        dest: /etc/chrony/chrony.conf
        content: |
          # Sync against internal time source node1 instead of public pool
          server {{ time_server_ip }} iburst prefer

          confdir /etc/chrony/conf.d
          sourcedir /etc/chrony/sources.d
          driftfile /var/lib/chrony/chrony.drift
          ntsdumpdir /var/lib/chrony
          logdir /var/log/chrony
          maxupdateskew 100.0
          rtcsync
          makestep 1 3
          leapsectz right/UTC
        owner: root
        group: root
        mode: "0644"
      notify: restart chrony

    - name: Ensure chrony is enabled and running
      systemd:
        name: chrony
        enabled: true
        state: started

    - name: Force initial sync burst against node1
      command: chronyc burst 4/4
      changed_when: false

  handlers:
    - name: restart chrony
      systemd:
        name: chrony
        state: restarted
EOF
